import subprocess, struct
def cli(port, *args):
    return subprocess.run(["redis-cli","-p",str(port)]+list(args),capture_output=True).stdout

for k in ("session:00697","session:00129","tags:126"):

    # decode rdb string length prefix
    fb=a[1]
    if fb>>6==0: hdrlen=2; L=fb&0x3F
    elif fb>>6==1: hdrlen=3; L=((fb&0x3F)<<8)|a[2]
    else: hdrlen=5; L=struct.unpack(">I",a[2:6])[0]
    data_start=1+hdrlen; data_end=data_start+L
    print("  L",L,"data bytes equal:", a[data_start:data_end]==b[data_start:data_end])
    ta=a[data_end:-8]; tb=b[data_end:-8]
    print("  ttl-section old", ta.hex(), "new", tb.hex())
    # interpret as seconds (FD + 4B BE) or ms (FC + 8B BE)
    def ttlsec(t):
        if len(t)==5 and t[0]==0xFD: return struct.unpack(">I",t[1:])[0],"s"
        if len(t)==9 and t[0]==0xFC: return struct.unpack(">Q",t[1:])[0]/1000,"ms"
        return t.hex(),"raw"
    print("  old ttl:",ttlsec(ta),"new ttl:",ttlsec(tb))
EOF
